postconditions.description: For each test case, the output line contains exactly n space-separated integers.

postconditions.expression: all(len(set(line.split())) == n for line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: All integers in each output sequence are distinct.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= 10**9 for line in stdout.splitlines() for x in line.split())

postconditions.expression: all((max(map(int, line.split())) - min(map(int, line.split()))) ** 2 == sum(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: For each output sequence, (max(a₁,...,aₙ) - min(a₁,...,aₙ))² equals the sum of the sequence.
